intro: Bolivia's economy relies on natural gas, minerals and farming, and it has huge lithium reserves.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Natural gas, zinc, silver, tin and gold are exported, along with soya. The salt flats hold some of the largest lithium reserves on Earth. A shortage of dollars and fuel hit the economy from 2023.

chapters.title: Coca
text: Coca leaves are chewed and brewed as tea traditionally, but are also used to make illegal cocaine.

cardGroups.title: Made in Bolivia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Bolivia makes and sells to the world.
